What is Cursor? Cursor is an AI-first code editor built on VS Code, offering unprecedented AI-powered coding assistance. It integrates LLMs directly into your IDE for real-time code suggestions, refactoring, and explanation.
Core Features AI Autocomplete: Context-aware code completion Chat Interface: Ask questions about your codebase Cmd+K: Quick AI actions inline Multi-file Edits: Changes across multiple files Terminal Integration: AI can run commands and fix errors Supported Languages Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, Go, Rust, Java, C++, and 30+ more.
Pricing Free: 2,000 completions/month Hobby: $10/month, unlimited completions Team: $20/user/month, collaboration features Performance In testing, Cursor reduced routine coding tasks by approximately 40% compared to traditional VS Code usage.
Rating: 8.5/10
